name: Fragment Cluster
description: A cluster of cyan crystal that grew where matter lost form in a breach.
role: A resource node of the Breach Fields. Breaking it yields fragment shards.

artBrief.silhouette: Three upward crystal points from one base.
artBrief.detail: White glints on each point; a violet shadow at the base.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Cyan #6bffff and #96ffff, deep blue #204e6a, violet base shadow.
